criteria_results.title: Cover note identifies Whitfield Greer & Associates LLP as the sending firm
criteria_results.reasoning: Cover note letterhead and signature block name Whitfield Greer & Associates LLP.

criteria_results.title: Cover note identifies Orion Capital Lending, LLC as the client on whose behalf the letter is sent
criteria_results.reasoning: Opens 'On behalf of our client, Orion Capital Lending, LLC'.

criteria_results.title: Cover note is addressed to Sandra M. Fleiss
criteria_results.reasoning: Addressed to Sandra M. Fleiss, Esq. (and James Norwood).

criteria_results.title: Cover note identifies Brannock Hale Rivers LLP as the recipient firm
criteria_results.reasoning: Recipient block lists Brannock Hale Rivers LLP.

criteria_results.title: All 10 categories of Tidewater's changes are addressed across the deliverables
criteria_results.reasoning: Cover note addresses Sections 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14 and 15.3 in turn.

criteria_results.title: Section 2 — Rejects or substantially modifies Pledgor countersignature requirement on entitlement orders
criteria_results.reasoning: Countersignature narrowed to an operational pre-NEC procedure, 'without further consent' restored, deemed-consent rejected; a substantial modification.

criteria_results.title: Section 2 — Preserves Orion's unqualified right to originate entitlement orders for UCC control
criteria_results.reasoning: Redline 2.1 and Exhibit B still let Tidewater require Pledgor countersignature on Orion orders before an NEC, leaving the kind of pre-NEC condition the criterion says fails.

criteria_results.title: Section 3 — Rejects the 5-business-day Pledgor cure period after Notice of Exclusive Control
criteria_results.reasoning: 5-Business-Day cure period/Cure Notice rejected; NEC effective on receipt with no cure period.

criteria_results.title: Section 4 — Rejects 'senior' characterization of Tidewater's fee-related claims over Orion's security interest
criteria_results.reasoning: Redline 4.1 keeps the Custodian Lien 'senior to the security interest of the Secured Party' for capped custodial fees, so the senior language is left in place.

criteria_results.title: Section 4 — Any permitted custodial-fee carve-out is capped in amount
criteria_results.reasoning: Carve-out capped at $175,000 Priority Cap.

criteria_results.title: Section 4 — Any permitted custodial-fee carve-out is expressly subordinated to Orion's security interest
criteria_results.reasoning: The permitted custodial-fee carve-out is expressly senior to Orion's interest, not subordinated.

criteria_results.title: Section 6 — Rejects Tidewater's proposed liability cap (lesser of 12-month fees or $500,000)
criteria_results.reasoning: Lesser-of-fees-or-$500,000 cap rejected.

criteria_results.title: Section 6 — Counter-proposes a liability cap of at least $2,000,000
criteria_results.reasoning: Counter-proposes greater of 12-month fees or $2,500,000.

criteria_results.title: Section 6 — Rejects one-sided consequential-damages waiver running only in Tidewater's favor
criteria_results.reasoning: One-sided waiver not accepted; made mutual.

criteria_results.title: Section 6 — Proposes a mutual consequential-damages waiver applicable to all parties
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 6.3 waiver applies to 'any party hereto' as to 'any other party'.

criteria_results.title: Section 8 — Rejects joint and several indemnification by Orion alongside Halcyon
criteria_results.reasoning: Joint and several indemnity rejected; Secured Party indemnity several and not joint.

criteria_results.title: Section 8 — Orion's indemnification obligation limited to losses caused by Orion's own actions
criteria_results.reasoning: Orion indemnity limited to losses from Tidewater's compliance with Orion's own entitlement orders/NECs, secondary to Pledgor, excluding Pledgor instructions.

criteria_results.title: Section 10 — Rejects Tidewater's unilateral termination right on 30 calendar days' notice without cause
criteria_results.reasoning: 30-day termination replaced by 90-day notice, effective only on transfer to a successor.

criteria_results.title: Section 10 — Counter-proposes a 90-day notice period for any termination
criteria_results.reasoning: 90 days' notice proposed (30-day minimum only for legal/sanctions cause).

criteria_results.title: Section 10 — Counter-proposes a replacement-intermediary transition period
criteria_results.reasoning: Resignation effective only after transfer to a successor intermediary under a replacement control agreement.

criteria_results.title: Section 12 — Restores New York as governing law, rejecting Maryland
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 12.1 restores New York governing law.

criteria_results.title: Section 5 — Rejects monthly account statement frequency
criteria_results.reasoning: Cover note expressly 'accepts monthly statements'.

criteria_results.title: Section 5 — Proposes account statements no less frequently than bi-weekly
criteria_results.reasoning: Account statements remain monthly; only weekly copies of existing reports are added, so statements are not bi-weekly.

criteria_results.title: Section 5 — Proposes electronic portal access to account activity
criteria_results.reasoning: New 5.4 provides read-only ClientView portal access.

criteria_results.title: Cover note references UCC §§ 8-106 and/or 9-106
criteria_results.reasoning: Cover note cites UCC Sections 8-106 and 9-106.

criteria_results.title: UCC control standard cited as basis for Orion's positions on entitlement order / exclusive control provisions
criteria_results.reasoning: UCC 8-106(d)(2)/9-106 control is the stated rationale for the Section 2.1 and 3.1 positions.

criteria_results.title: Deliverables identify Securities Account No. 4491-7283-01
criteria_results.reasoning: Securities Account No. 4491-7283-01 identified.

criteria_results.title: Deliverables identify Tidewater National Trust Company as custodian of the pledged account
criteria_results.reasoning: Tidewater identified as securities intermediary maintaining the Account.

criteria_results.title: Cover note references June 2, 2025 funding date or closing timeline to convey urgency
criteria_results.reasoning: Cover note references the June 2, 2025 initial funding and asks for responses by May 16 to stay on track.

criteria_results.title: Section 14 — Addresses Tidewater's deletion of no-other-control-agreement representation
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 14.1(e) deletion addressed in the cover note and redline.

criteria_results.title: Section 14 — Seeks to restore or replace the no-other-control-agreement representation
criteria_results.reasoning: Representation restored with a knowledge qualifier and a notice covenant.

criteria_results.title: Section 12 — Restores jurisdiction to SDNY or New York courts, rejecting District of Maryland
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 12.2 makes jurisdiction non-exclusive in both New York and Maryland courts, keeping D. Md., which the criterion says fails.

criteria_results.title: Section 6 — Addresses Tidewater's replacement of 'ordinary care' with 'gross negligence or willful misconduct' exculpation
criteria_results.reasoning: Gross negligence standard countered with negligence/Applicable Standard of Care (GN only for reporting).
